title: Liquidity bot: PnL
description: Sub-page of the Liquidity bot board in the liquidity folder. The SPA's PnL tab, tiles, table and charts all driven by the range pill; closed-lot and cost-ledger drilldowns live in the SPA.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: GCP project id — both the Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging queries take it directly.

list.name: window
list.label: PnL range
list.description: Matches the SPA's PnL range buttons. Windows are relative to the last date with fills, not to today.

panels.description: The SPA header's connection light: is the bot process up and answering /health? '—' means the exporter itself is not reporting.

Deployed commit, from /health, cut to 7 characters like the SPA header. The stackdriver plugin runs a range query even for an instant target, so over the dashboard's 24h the previous commit is a second series and its name drew over this one. PromQL also keeps a stopped series for its 5m lookback, so topk on the sample timestamp keeps only the commit with the newest sample, over a 1m window.
Bot process uptime, from /health uptimeSeconds.
The SPA settings bar's Broker pill.

USDC rebalance target. The SPA pill also shows the band: target +/- liq_settings_usdc_deviation.
Hedge execution threshold (settings bar 'Trigger').

panels.title: Per Asset PnL
panels.description: The SPA's Per Asset PnL table (closed-lot replay per symbol; Lots = matched lot count; Volume = both legs of the matched shares, without the SPA's USD sub-line).

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="gross_realized",window="$window"}, "col", "Gross", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="tracked_costs",window="$window"}, "col", "Costs", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="tracked_revenue",window="$window"}, "col", "Revenue", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="net_realized",window="$window"}, "col", "Net", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="counter_trade",window="$window"}, "col", "Counter", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="onchain_netting",window="$window"}, "col", "On-chain", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="directional_imbalance_excess",window="$window"}, "col", "Directional", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="directional_inventory_baseline",window="$window"}, "col", "Baseline Drift", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_usd{col="total",window="$window"}, "col", "Total", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_lots{window="$window"}, "col", "Lots", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_pnl_symbol_volume_shares{window="$window"}, "col", "Volume", "", ""))

panels.title: PnL by Asset per Time Unit
panels.description: One bar per calendar day, split by asset and stacked, straight from the bot's daily PnL buckets. A day with no closed lot for an asset is a zero, as in the SPA.

panels.title: PnL by PnL-Stream per Time Unit
panels.description: The same days split by PnL stream, the SPA's four component streams only, since directional_exposure and total are tile-only aggregates there and stacking them beside their own components double-counts.

panels.title: Cumulative PnL by Asset
panels.description: Running total per asset through the selected range. Unstacked: the SPA draws one independent line per asset here, not a stack. The last day's bars sum to the Total PnL tile above.

panels.title: Cumulative PnL by PnL-Stream
panels.description: Running total per stream, unstacked like the SPA's lines. Grafana has no categorical-axis line chart, so these are bars over the same day buckets: the numbers are the SPA's, the shape is not.
